messages:
marie_support: FYI customer (AcmePay) hitting intermittent 502/504s on hosted API, p95 spikes to ~12s. They pasted sample curl and said it started ~10:30 UTC. request-id: rq_9a2f
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/2026.03.17-alloc-tuning @ 10:12 UTC (image: inference-runtime:v2.4.1) :white_check_mark:
aj_eng: ack, looking. are the errors 5xx gateway or downstream model timeouts? any repro payload?
marie_support: Most are gateway 504, a few 502s. Customer sent this simple repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-XXXXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"open-llm-xxl","input":"summarize this...","max_tokens":1024}' -v
```
marie_support: They also said bursty traffic (many short requests, 1-2s each) started after a job ramp.
samir_infra: I'm pulling traces and queue metrics. I can already see continuous-batcher queue depth jumping at 10:11–10:25 UTC, backlog ~13k requests, per-host kv-cache miss rate up, batch latency tail rising.
elaine_sre: @samir_infra can you paste the queue depth/time series + any 5xx error logs? need to know if it's enqueue saturation vs dequeue slowdowns.
samir_infra: Here are snippets from queue metric and logs:
```
metrics: continuous_batcher.queue_depth{pool="hosted-xxl"} 13072 1658069400
metrics: continuous_batcher.dequeue_latency_p95 9.8 1658069400
logs: gateway.go: RequestEnqueue timeout after 12000ms, err="queue: max depth exceeded" request_id=rq_9a2f
logs: batcher.go: Dequeue blocked waiting for kv-cache load; kvcache_miss=true host=host-12
```
samir_infra: config change note: we rolled out "alloc-tuning" that reduced batcher worker count from 6 -> 4 on hosted-xxl to free GPUs for dedications. rollout at 10:05 UTC per deploy-bot.
aj_eng: that matches timing. fewer workers -> slower dequeue -> queue depth climb -> tail timeouts.
marie_support: Customer asking for ETA and mitigation; they're on live traffic.
elaine_sre: Immediate mitigations: 1) revert alloc-tuning on hosted-xxl (restore worker=6) 2) temporary route AcmePay to fallback small-variant model (open-llm-xl) 3) enable early-reject policy for requests older than 8s so downstream doesn't pile up. Which one can we action fastest?
aj_eng: I can roll back alloc-tuning now. rolling back to worker=6 for hosted-xxl.
deploy-bot: rollback started: config/alloc-tuning -> previous @ 10:36 UTC
samir_infra: After rollback we should watch queue_depth and dequeue_p95. I'll tail metrics.
elaine_sre: Also add quick rule to console: per-tenant ingress limit 600rps for AcmePay while we stabilize. @customer_ops can we coordinate with AcmePay to throttle?
customer_ops: pinged the account rep, they agreed to apply a short throttle for the next 20m.
samir_infra: Post-rollback snapshot (10:40 UTC): queue_depth dropped to ~2.1k over 3m, dequeue_p95 -> 1.6s, 5xxs reduced. still observing some sticky tail requests from earlier backlog; running targeted evictions on hosts with kvcache miss storms.
marie_support: I'll update the customer and keep thread open. thanks all. :heart:
elaine_sre: Follow-ups: 1) add canary rollback gating for alloc-tuning (don't change worker_count across entire pool at once) 2) add an alert that triggers early for continuous-batcher.dequeue_p95 > 2s AND queue_depth > 5k 3) add runbook steps for tenant routing/fallback model. I'll create tickets.
marie_support: creating incident ticket INC-2026-0132 with notes and actions.
